subject: Christmas is Coming – Prepare with Luca
body:
In three days we celebrate Christmas, the birth of Christ—a time of joy, love, and spiritual renewal.

Master taught that Christmas represents not just the birth of Jesus, but the birth of Christ consciousness within each of us. It is a time to celebrate the divine potential within every soul and to renew our commitment to the spiritual path.

As we prepare for this sacred celebration, let us reflect on the deeper meaning of Christmas and how we can experience the birth of Christ consciousness in our own lives.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this Christmas bring you closer to the experience of divine love and Christ consciousness.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
